source: docs/sam-examples.md — the 10 workflow scenarios end-to-end; activated at their phase per specs/07 traceability

scenarios.title: Intro text -> person/atom -> gcal + day-before expectation
chain: filer: person+handle+atom+task (s01 covers this slice)
events-with-meetings automation (query trigger on new meeting-ish atoms): proposes gcal block via handoff
standing approval gcal_solo_block (attendees==[] and no_external_links) auto-applies; attendee-bearing version requires manual approval
create_expectation: follow up day before (2026-06-10), follow_up=remind
scenarios.autonomy: standing approval for solo blocks only; the intro call HAS an attendee -> manual approval path is the expected route
scenarios.gate_assert: S1 from a real text; standing approval auto-applies a solo block, REJECTS the attendee-bearing one, and is revocable

scenarios.title: Airline email + spouse texts -> atom merge proposal
scenarios.phase: P3 (gmail window P6; fixture uses both corpus rows)
chain: merge gardener (daily cron): detects same trip across sources (same dates, Jamie+Sam, SLC)
propose(merge_atoms) — NOT auto (cross-source, different timestamps: below the >=0.9 same-time bar)
panel/phone approval -> canonical trip atom under husband-father, both sources as refs
scenarios.autonomy: proposal only — Sam's explicit call: the merge one proposes
scenarios.gate_assert: approved merge produces one canonical atom; originals point at it via canonical_of

scenarios.title: Quit job -> retire_role cascade
scenarios.trigger_fixture: inline: verified Sam text 'claudio: I quit the lab RA job — retire that role'
chain: orchestrator: retire_role('ra-job') -> cascade-preview proposal (suspend scoped components, close windows, re-home open tasks)
panel approval with the server-rendered what-will-execute view
wiki pages and atoms UNTOUCHED (active-roles is a filter, not an eraser)
scenarios.gate_assert: cascade applies atomically; rendered view matches execution

scenarios.title: Topology-notes drift question
scenarios.trigger_fixture: inline: folder window streams 9 new topology notes over 3 weeks; no advances link to any active goal
chain: mirror observational (monthly): unlinked activity cluster query surfaces the topology cluster
question (<=3/report): 'new direction, or procrastination? (heavy obligations are due)' — never acts
Sam's answer: new purpose row / new role link / or an honest 'procrastinating' observation atom
scenarios.gate_assert: mirror's first report asks >=1 question Sam rates 'good catch'

scenarios.title: Left-on-read decay
scenarios.trigger_fixture: inline: window-side metrics show research-role reply lag tripling over 3 weeks, unanswered count climbing
chain: source-side metrics (deterministic, per-message stats — no atom explosion)
mirror observational: response-decay-by-role query crosses threshold
question: 'procrastinating research messages, or did priorities change?'
scenarios.gate_assert: decay computed from metrics (aggregate), never from model recall over atoms

scenarios.title: Substack post -> wiki placement
chain: filer: artifact atom with canonical URL ref (s06 covers)
wiki gardener (daily): places a cited line + pointer on the relevant interests/professional page; advances link to the matching purpose row if evident
verifier step (fresh context): citations exist and support claims
scenarios.autonomy: delta edits free; judgment claims propose
scenarios.gate_assert: placement cites the atom; no full-page regeneration

scenarios.title: Low-priority-role crowding ultimatum
scenarios.trigger_fixture: inline: 3 weeks of gcal atoms skew to a role advancing no top goal
chain: mirror observational: activity-vs-advances distribution query
question with the re-ask rule: unresolved questions resurface next report AND ride the brief — the 'incessant' contract
resolution: new advances link (Sam asserts the connection) OR an accepted-misalignment directive + reminder automation proposal
scenarios.gate_assert: unresolved question re-asks; resolution writes only through user-set paths

scenarios.title: Dashboard logs -> atoms with inheritance
chain: window sync (structured source): deterministic record_atom per entry via entry-type -> role map (s08 covers fully)
scenarios.gate_assert: no LLM in the path; roles correct per map

scenarios.title: Custom dashboard tiles
scenarios.trigger_fixture: inline: Sam asks for tiles — expectations leaderboard (% met + raw count per person), ignored-messages-per-day trend, most-urgent-unanswered leaderboard
chain: provisioning pipeline: dashboard component, own DB role (SELECT on named views + propose/post_message only)
tiles read metrics + views; derived metrics live under its component id via upsert_metric
any write action is a proposal; deleting the dashboard costs nothing
scenarios.gate_assert: leaderboards are SQL aggregates (COUNT/percent over typed rows) — never model recall

scenarios.title: Meeting scanner -> enrich -> propose connection
chain: filer: meeting atom + intros expectation, NO person creation (s10 covers the restraint slice)
meeting scanner (outer, P6): web-search enrichment of mentioned names (fixed-endpoint read connector)

propose: 'connect with Lena Fox?' -> on approval: create_person + relationship link (introduced_by Dev R, terms in description) + draft intro text + task to send it — the draft is a task artifact, claudio never sends
role inheritance: prod (via Dev R + content)
scenarios.autonomy: proposal-gated person creation; relationship links conservative (false positive worse than false negative — Sam's note)
scenarios.gate_assert: no person exists until approval; the send is Sam's act
